what: The plan says glibc 2.28 has every symbol std's Linux code links. A blaze-built hello world on aarch64 Linux (readelf --dyn-syms, 2026-11-12) imports fstat64, stat64, lstat64 and fstat at GLIBC_2.33: before 2.33 they are wrappers in libc_nonshared.a around __fxstat64 and its kin, not symbols of libc.so.6.
cost: an hour designing around a default the plan called settled
cause: the claim was reasoned from rustc's 2.17 floor, which holds only with libc_nonshared.a on the link line; nothing measured it
workaround: the start object blaze-link ships carries the eight stat wrappers for a release before 2.33
fix: the plan's sentence corrected in the same change; the row's check links std at the default release
